title: Show inquiry quotation response times
description: Add a development-only read-only inquiry response workspace using persisted Quotation.InquiryId and Inquiry/Quotation dates. Treat missing links and quotation dates preceding the inquiry as separate evidence; do not infer links from text or alter conversion status. No migration, production SQL, real database execution, irreversible data action, secret change or deployment.
acceptance_criteria: An authenticated bounded GET workspace filters inquiries by date range and optional customer, applies existing salesperson data scope, and pages by stable inquiry ID.

Each inquiry shows the first valid explicitly linked quotation date, elapsed calendar days, and distinct unquoted or inconsistent-link states; soft-deleted rows and quotation revisions never inflate the response count.
The inquiry page opens a read-only response-time workspace with date/customer filters and clear missing or anomalous evidence.
Focused unit tests cover scope, linkage, revisions, missing dates, negative intervals, paging and no-write behavior; safe Release validation passes and rules are documented.
